beepAndLedCodes.summary: Normal POST pass on modern AMI UEFI (or DRAM refresh failure if screen stays permanently black).
Memory parity / early DRAM detection failure during PEI.
Base 64KB memory read/write test failure (classic AMI RAM fault).
System timer (RTC / programmable interval timer) failure or severe memory error.
Processor error (or on Gigabyte/ASRock UEFI, missing console/GPU output when no iGPU is present).
Gate A20 / Super I/O keyboard controller failure.
Video / Graphics initialization error (no PCIe GPU or failed DisplayPort handshake).
ASUS/AMI UEFI no-VGA detected (or extended memory test failure on legacy AMI).
Hardware component failure — commonly CPU fan missing, over-temperature, or VRM fault on ASUS AMI UEFI.
Display memory (VRAM) read/write error on discrete graphics card.
Award BIOS video adapter initialization failure.
Award BIOS DRAM not detected or improperly seated.
CPU overheating, dead CPU fan, or VRM out-of-spec voltage alarm.
No video card detected or faulty GPU RAM on Award BIOS.
AUTOSIZE DRAM failure — memory missing, unseated, or unsupported.
BIOS ROM checksum error — corrupted SPI flash firmware.
DRAM refresh test failure.
Video memory initialization failure.
HP Main BIOS area corrupted (checksum failure).
HP Embedded Controller timed out waiting for BIOS memory initialization (RAM fault).
HP graphics controller initialization timeout.
HP Embedded Controller timed out waiting for power rail good (Power Good / VRM fault).
HP CPU not detected or failed core initialization.
HP Embedded Controller cannot reach BIOS within timeout (Board / SPI / EC communication fault).
HP BIOS recovery in progress or attempting secondary rollback image.
Dell CPU failure (Processor initialization fault).
Dell System Board: BIOS or ROM checksum failure.
Dell No Memory / RAM detected.
Dell Memory / RAM failure (detected but failed training/test).
Dell LCD failure (internal eDP screen cable or panel fault; RAM on older OptiPlex).
Dell CMOS coin-cell battery failure.
Dell PCI / Video card or chip failure.
Dell BIOS Recovery image not found (3A-3W) or recovery image invalid (3A-4W).
Classic ThinkPad DIMM / memory not detected or incompatible.
ThinkPad video / display initialization fault (or system board).
ThinkPad Security Chip (TPM / TCG) communication failure.
ThinkPad system board / security hardware fault.
Modern ThinkPads (T480/T14/X1 Carbon) encode 4-digit hex errors into a short musical tone.
ASUS Q-LED halted at DRAM detection or DDR5 memory training.
ASUS Q-LED halted at CPU initialization.
ASUS Q-LED halted at GPU / display output handshake.
ASUS Q-LED passed CPU/RAM/GPU and stopped because no bootable OS drive was found (or you are in BIOS).
MSI EZ Debug LED: CPU not detected or failed initialization.
MSI EZ Debug LED: RAM not detected or failed training.
Normal MSI AM5 DDR5 first-boot memory training state (fault only if stuck > 4 minutes).
MSI EZ Debug LED: Graphics card not detected or failed init.
MSI EZ Debug LED: Booting device not detected or failed (CPU/RAM/GPU all passed!).
